properties.description:
Three tests in `crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_design_that_publishes_contracts_publishes_intent.rs`: a design publishing a boundary and no requirement is asked about it; publishing ONE requirement silences it; a design publishing no boundary at all is never asked.

OBSERVED FAILING first — the first test red, the other two passing vacuously, which is exactly the shape a detector's tests take before the detector exists.

ALSO CHECKED AGAINST THE REAL DESIGN, both sides of the fix: with 3 published Interfaces and 0 published Requirements the condition held; after six requirements were marked `published` on Anthony's word it does not.

RE-RUN: `cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test a_design_that_publishes_contracts_publishes_intent`.
properties.findings: 3/3 green 2026-09-22 after the first was observed red. On the real design the predicate went from true (3 published boundaries, 0 of 262 requirements published) to false (6 published).
properties.name: Fires on a published contract with no published promise, quiet at one, quiet when nothing is published
